data.title: 信浓 · 浴后和室的狐尾轻抚
data.description: 浴后的重樱卧房内水汽未散，清雅的熏香弥漫四周。信浓侧倚在榻榻米靠垫上，仅裹着轻软的浴袍，湿润的银发垂散腰际。她单手轻抚怀中抱着的蓬松狐尾，狐耳尖泛着淡淡粉红，眼帘低垂微微轻颤，展现出平日不可多见的青涩与敏感神态。
data.location: warm tatami chamber with steam drifting from nearby bath
data.action: reclining sideways on tatami holding one of her fluffy fox tails in arms, loose bathrobe exposing collarbone, wet hair ends, fox ears flushed pink, blushing tenderly
data.lighting: warm amber paper lamp glow creating soft intimate contrast
data.promptProse: Reclining on a tatami mat in a loosely tied bathrobe after a warm bath, Shinano hugs a fluffy white tail close to her chest. Her fox ears are tinged pink with a shy, sweet expression in warm lamplight.
data.animaCaption: Shinano hugging her fluffy tail on tatami after a bath, glowing softly in warm lantern light.
